mentions.name: Perl Tiny URL
mentions.description: A tiny URL shortener written in Perl and meant to run locally, providing short URLs for internal/VPN resources on a per-client basis. It typically runs as a small daemon or container per client and serves a dashboard of frequently or recently used links; security is intentionally minimal since it is local, omitting authentication.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also built a tiny URL system in Perl <https://gitlab.com/siddfinch/perl-tiny-url>, meant to run locally. The idea is simple: short URLs for internal/VPN resources per client. I usually spin up a small daemon (or container) per client and get a dashboard of links I use frequently or recently.
